push.title: Outbound Webhooks - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Sigpot ya na-customize ed kada webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), odino say sarilin Custom body template ya walay <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (alimbawa <example></example> ) - singa say pan-fill in na cURL command ya maminsan.
push.curlLabel: I-paste so cURL na CRM na kliyente yo
push.curlHelp: I-paste so alimbawan kerew ya iter API docs odino Postman da (ya walay tua odino sample ya data). Say URL , paraan tan saray header et nakopya ya singa-wala, tan kada key ed laman et nilista ed leksab pian napili yo no dinan ya CRM field so manpano ed kada lead.

push.howFilledCustom: Custom - isulat so sarilim ya request body tan ipelag moy anggan iner; balang sakey et isalat ed peteg a balor na lead antis ya ipawit. Pindoten so sakey a variable ed leksab pian isuksok itan.

receive.title: Awaten - Awaten iray Lead ed Antokaman a Format
receive.intro: Kada lapuan et walay sarili ton URL . Ituro so Facebook lead ads, Zapier , sakey a website form odino webhook na arum nin CRM - mangipapawit ira na saray lead ed dilin JSON odino form format da, tan i-map mo ray field da ed field mo.

pull.title: Pull - Fetch Leads from Any API
pull.intro: Leadrat et ontawag ed API na sananey a sistema diad sakey ya eskedyul (antokaman ya auth, antokaman ya paging) tan i-import to ray rekord ya ipawil to. Saray rekord ya anengneng to antis ya na-update so parehon lead.
pull.variables: Saray variable: <since></since> (unor ya matalonan impandalagan, oras na ISO; anggapoy karga to nen inmunan pankanawnawa), <others></others>

api.title: API yo - Duaran-Dalan ya Pakaloob parad Antokaman a Sistema
api.intro: Antokaman ya sistema ya walay API key mo et makapanggawa, makabasa tan maka-update na saray lead tan makapan-subscribe ed saray lead events. Ipawit so key ed <hdr></hdr> header, bilang <bearer></bearer> , odino (no ag sarag na tool ya i-set iray header) bilang <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} ya kerew kada minuto.
api.noPermission: Say toon walaan labat na Manage Settings ya permiso so makanengneng ed API key.
api.shownOnce: Kopyaen mo yan key natan tan isimpen mo ed maligen a pasen - parad seguridad et maminsan labat ya nipanengneng. No naandi, manggawa kay balon sakey.
api.regenerateConfirm: Manggawa na balon API key? Say kaplesan ya key et ontunda lan tampol ya mankimey parad kada sistema ya manguusar ed satan.
api.openApiHint: I-import so OpenAPI spec ed Postman , Zapier , Make o n8n pian akaparaan ya usaren so kada endpoint.
